# Tommy Roldan — Miami Web Developer & Designer

> Freelance web developer and designer based in Miami, Florida, building websites,
> e-commerce storefronts, iOS/Android apps, and custom AI agents for startups and
> small businesses. Shipping production work since 2015. Fluent in English and
> Spanish, and available for new projects.

Tommy Roldan works across four areas: fast marketing websites, e-commerce and
Shopify storefronts, cross-platform mobile apps built with React Native and Expo,
and custom AI agents and workflow automation. He also serves as CTO and Head of
LATAM Sales at TerryCo Group.

Typical stack: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Node.js, React
Native, Expo, Shopify/Liquid, and Python.

This site is published in both English and Spanish. Content is server-prerendered,
so every page below returns complete HTML without requiring JavaScript execution.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tommyroldan.com/): Overview of services, featured projects, and a FAQ answering the most common questions about cost, timelines, and scope.
- [Work](https://tommyroldan.com/work/): Full portfolio — apps, web platforms, AI agents, tools, and archived early work.
- [About](https://tommyroldan.com/about/): Background, experience, and the story from Medellín to Miami.
- [Tools](https://tommyroldan.com/tools/): Free browser-based utilities built to solve real problems.
- [Contact](https://tommyroldan.com/contact/): Project inquiry form — the way to start a project.

## Products

- [Canary](https://tommyroldan.com/canary/): Free Windows diagnostic tool that finds failing drives and crash causes that vendor software reports as healthy. Reads the SMART counters other tools skip, explains findings in plain English, and says "could not verify" rather than pretending a check passed.
- [PPT Speech](https://tommyroldan.com/ppt-speech/): Upload any .pptx and have it read aloud slide by slide using your browser's built-in voices. Runs entirely client-side — no server, no upload.

## Selected client work

- [WrapMe](https://wrapme.app): Real-time 3D configurator for vehicle wrap and paint shops. Customers orbit their own car in the browser and try real films across six independently painted zones, rendered live in WebGL.
- [Roldan Group](https://buildroldan.com): Site for a family exterior construction and remodelling business, including Pool Vision, an AI feature that previews the finished result on a homeowner's own property.
- [Clear Care Dental](https://app.clearcaredentalgroup.com/login): Full-stack dental benefits platform in React Native and Expo. Members find in-network dentists, track plan usage in real time, and book visits from one cross-platform app.
- [Clear Care Dental Enterprise](https://clearcaredentalenterprise.com/): Enterprise dashboard handling benefits administration, member management, and practice operations at scale.
- [Dolce Vita Supplements](https://www.dolcevitasupplements.com/): Shopify e-commerce brand for sublingual supplement strips, with editorial storefront design and a frictionless checkout.
- [Versatile Customs](https://versatile-customs.vercel.app): Storefront for a vehicle wrap studio, built around the 3D visualizer, covering PPF, colour-change wraps, ceramic tint, and lighting.
- [World Resort Rescue](https://worldresortrescue.com): Full redesign of a consumer-facing resort services site — rebuilt structure, clearer navigation, modern responsive front end.
- [Cuatro Group](https://cuatro-group.vercel.app/en): Multilingual corporate site, fully internationalized for a global audience.
- [NST Redesign](https://nst-redesign.vercel.app): Ground-up redesign of the NST Pharma site in React, Vite, and Tailwind.
